import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png'); hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
# masks in hsv OpenCV. print comps for orange, blue, black, pale card
specs={
'orange':((0,90,80),(25,255,255)),
'blue':((90,55,20),(130,255,220)),
'black':((0,0,0),(179,255,45)),
'whitecard':((0,0,155),(179,45,225)),
'wood':((0,35,40),(25,200,160)),
}
for name,(lo,hi) in specs.items():
 m=cv2.inRange(hsv,np.uint8(lo),np.uint8(hi)); n,lab,stats,cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
 print('\\n',name,'count',np.count_nonzero(m))
 for i in sorted(range(1,n),key=lambda z:stats[z,4],reverse=True)[:20]:
  x,y,w,h,a=stats[i];print(a,(x,y,w,h),tuple(np.round(cents[i],1)))
# edge lines
ed=cv2.Canny(im,50,120)
lines=cv2.HoughLinesP(ed,1,np.pi/180,threshold=100,minLineLength=100,maxLineGap=10)
print('\\nlines')
for l in (lines[:50] if lines is not None else []): print(l[0].tolist())
PY"

  s+=c
